title: Types of landscapes
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:15Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point, geo-landscapes-landforms, teaches the difference between a landscape and a landform, not the set of landscape types with their own landforms, and it does not cover riverine or volcanic landscapes, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Types of landscapes
card: Landscapes can be grouped into types by their main features. Six common types are mountain, coastal, riverine, desert, rainforest and volcanic landscapes.
high, steep land with peaks and valleys. Coastal landscapes are found where land meets the sea, with landforms such as cliffs and beaches.
shaped by rivers and the land beside them, with landforms such as floodplains and meanders. Desert landscapes are very dry, with landforms such as sand dunes.
dense, tall forest in a wet climate. Volcanic landscapes are shaped by lava and ash from volcanoes, with landforms such as craters and cones.
draft.remember: Each type of landscape has its own main features and its own landforms.

a.q: A landscape has sand dunes and very little rain. Which type of landscape is it?
a.why: Sand dunes and very dry conditions are features of a desert landscape. A coastal landscape can have sand too, but it is found where land meets the sea, and this one is described by its dryness.
a.clue: Think about the amount of water in the area.

b.q: Priya visits a place with a wide, flat floodplain and a river that curves in large meanders. Which type of landscape is it?
b.why: Floodplains and meanders are landforms made by a river, so this is a riverine landscape. A rainforest can also have rivers, but it is defined by dense, tall forest in a wet climate, which is not what Priya describes.
b.clue: What shaped the floodplain and the meanders?
